Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http://www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 140 s. 2022 October 27, 2022 SAMSON R. DUMANJUG Mayor EVELYN C. DUMANJUG Vice-Mayor Municipality of Bonifacio Province of Misamis Occidental Dear Mayor S. Dumanjug and Vice-Mayor E. Dumanjug: This has reference to your letter dated October 17, 2022 requesting guidance on the following queries: 1. Is an Oath of Office and the installation of the acting mayor by way of preventive suspension necessary in order the said mayor can lawfully perform his duties and responsibilities? 2. Who has the authority to serve the said preventive suspension order and who is authorized by law to install [the] acting mayor? 3. Can a governor who issued a suspension order can order the assumption of the acting mayor in our case? If no, who has authority to do so? 4. Is the presence of the several members of the PNP of Misamis Occidental in the service of the suspension orders necessary in the absence of clear and present danger? If necessary, who has the proper party to request the same? 5. Can the concerned DILG Officials be administratively sanctioned for their failure to facilitate necessary interventions to prevent any impasse of the operations of the LGU-Bonifacio, Misamis Occidental considering that it is very clear that the said assailed suspensions were illegal per se in accordance with Section 62(c), R.A. 7160 and pertinent DILG Opinions which they are well aware of? Your queries arose from the following antecedent facts: • On September 14, 2022, an Administrative Complaint for Grave Abuse of Authority was filed by Punong Barangay Raymund Retubado and Elsa Colegado; • An answer with Motion for Inhibition was filed and on October 3, 2022, a notice for Preliminary Conference was sent to you. In response you filed a Motion for Deferment; • On October 5, 2022, an order for Preventive Suspension signed by Governor Henry S. Oaminal was served to you by the Provincial Legal Officer with the assistance of several fully armed members Of the PNP led by PCoI Anthony Placido and a certain PMajor Agustine Arazo; Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

• You filed a Petition for Certiorari with prayer for issuance of Temporary Restraining Order, Preliminary Injunction and Injunction before the Regional Trial Court of Tangub City and a summary hearing was conducted on October 14, 2022 relative thereto; On October 6, 2022, the Committee hearing the case issued an order declaring you in default and resolved the Motion for Inhibition; and • On the day of the implementation of the suspension order, you were informed that the Municipal Local Government Operations Officer (MLGOO) was nowhere to be found and was replaced on October 6, 2022. The new MGLOO assigned in the municipality, allegedly, did not intervene to resolve the controversy arising from the issuance of preventive suspension and as a result there was chaos on the operations of the municipality. Foremost, it was established that the conduct of investigation and the issuance of preventive suspension was done before Republic Act No. 119351 was signed into law. Hence, the 90-day prohibition period provided under Section 62 (c) of Republic Act No. 7160 (RA 7160) is operational. Counting from December 5, 2022, the scheduled BSKE, the 90-day prohibition will commence on September 5, 2022. From said period, no investigations nor preventive suspension will be conducted and issued. Considerably, the issuance of the preventive suspension and subsequent implementation is an ultra vires act violative of Section 62 (c) of RA 7160. Nevertheless, for academic purposes, this Department will provide responses to your aforementioned queries. On your first query, this Department opines in the negative. Section 46 of RA 7160 clearly provides that in case of temporary incapacity of the municipal mayor, either physical or legal reasons, the vice-mayor shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties of the local chief executive. However, since the vice-mayor is also preventively suspended, the provision under Section 44 of RA 7160 may be observed pursuant to the Supreme Court pronouncement in Menzon vs. Petilla2. In such case of temporary incapacity of the Mayor and Vice-Mayor, the highest ranking sanggunian member or, in case of his/her temporary inability, the second highest ranking sanggunian member, shall fill in the vacancy. Subsequent vacancies in the office shall be filled automatically by the other sanggunian members according to their ranking. In both instances, the assumption of the highest and the second highest sangguniang bayan member as Acting Mayor and Acting Vice-Mayor is by operation of law, hence, there is no need for them to take their oath of office before they perform the duties and functions of the mayor and vice-mayor, respectively. The second and third query. will be answered simultaneously. Under Section 63 of RA 7160, it is the Governor who imposes the preventive suspension of municipal elective officials. The Governor may direct any personnel under his authority to serve and implement the order of preventive suspension. With the imposition of preventive 1 The act postponing the barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections from December 5, 2022 to last Monday of October 2023 2 G.R. No. 90762. May 20, 1991. Page 2 of 3

Suspension, the mayor and the vice-mayor are legally incapacitated to perform their duties and functions and the provisions of temporary vacancies will apply. As previously discussed, the assumption of the acting mayor and acting vice-mayor is by operation of law, there is no need for appointment before the said officials perform the duties and functions of the office. In the fourth query relative to the presence of the police officers during the implementation of the preventive suspension, this Department cannot properly opine on its impropriety based only on the narrations provided in the letter. But police assistance may be requested by the implementing authority for the proper implementation of the order of preventive suspension. As to the fi.@b--g-u.e.CY' this Department interposes the same reasoning that it cannot decide on the allegation that MLGOO did not intervene in the situation of the Municipality based on the said narrations. However, please be informed that the MLGOO cannot immediately advise on the propriety of the implementation of the preventive suspension considering that the order was issued by the Governor who is outside his/her jurisdiction. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: TOR R. LLAMAS secretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs LLLS/OD/RPB/518 cc: DIR. WILHELM M. SUYKO Regional Director DILG Region X
